read_back_from: /logs/harness/feed.json budget and tokens_fed, written by tests/runner.py inside the verifier's own process from the corpus it fed.
why_it_is_load_bearing: Before this row the graded path only ever compared tokens_fed against whatever budget the pool bytes happened to declare, so the value was self-referential and the environment was not load-bearing for it. tests/budget_spec.json is generated here from substrate.budget_tokens and is verifier-side, so the gate now depends on the number itself: a feed ledger graded against any other budget scores zero, and the bound evaluation point is budget exhaustion measured against the frozen figure rather than against a drifting one.
